snapshot.preflight: Read-only metadata SQL first: current_database/current_user/version/readOnly/recovery status; non-system schemas; extensions; relation kinds; large-object count; sequence count and live values; current-role privilege flags. Reject non-public application schemas, partitioned/foreign/materialized relations, large objects or unsupported extensions rather than silently omit them. Any sequence values need a separate freshness/maintenance-boundary qualification because they are not MVCC snapshot state.
snapshot.clientGate: Use official PostgreSQL17 psql/pg_dump/pg_restore matching source17 and intended local17 restore; verify client binaries/versions. If absent, prepare official vendor clients in Infrastructure only after approval; no primary Infrastructure tooling installation. Source major change requires review, not a silent older/newer client substitution.
snapshot.connectionFile: New0600 no-symlink single-link file; no credential URI in argv/stdout, no inherited libpq service/startup/options.
snapshot.transaction: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; SELECT pg_export_snapshot(); keep that transaction open until every original-column fingerprint and pg_dump child completes.
snapshot.dump: pg_dump --format=custom --no-owner --no-acl --schema=public --lock-wait-timeout=5s --snapshot=<exported>; existing helper bounds output before writing.
snapshot.outputs: New directory0700, source.dump0600 and capture.json0600; source version/table+original-column counts/hashes and migration history; aggregate only in stdout; no rows/ciphertext/URIs/raw exceptions.
snapshot.freshness: Concurrent production writers remain running. This is a consistent ordinary-table rehearsal snapshot, not a write-stop/final cutover boundary; no production mutation or scheduler change.

keyContinuity.formatOnly: ENCRYPTION_KEY exactly64 hex; COOKIE_SECRET nonempty bounded exact bytes, no CR/LF. Capture named keys only; never replace them with preview/synthetic keys.
keyContinuity.privateComparison: Use primary-owned random audit HMAC key to fingerprint decoded encryption bytes and exact cookie-secret bytes privately; transfer/readback must compare equal with only booleans emitted. Never publish key values or key fingerprints.
keyContinuity.encryptionProof: On the isolated restored copy only, run the existing AES-GCM decrypt function against original encrypted credential fields; require authenticated decrypt success, report counts/booleans, immediately discard plaintext. Never contact Coder/OAuth or rotate the captured tokens.
keyContinuity.cookieProof: Synthetic product sign/verify with retained cookie key checks local function compatibility only. Matching Secret value plus private transfer equality preserves intended signing identity; it does not prove a running old process has reloaded that Secret or that any actual historical cookie remains valid.
keyContinuity.sessionLimit: Current host-only purpose-separated cookie semantics reject legacy names/origins and some historical signatures even with the same key. No live login, personal browser cookie access, universal session-continuity claim or production secret binding write.
